create_FPGMPruner: create an FPGMPruner instance with a configurable sparsity level and distance metric
build_FPGMPruner_L2: build an FPGMPruner using L2 distance to prune convolutional filters by geometric median
run_FPGMPruner_update_mask: run the FPGMPruner update_mask method to zero out least similar convolutional filters
test_FPGMPruner_distance: test the FPGMPruner _compute_distance method on a 4D convolutional weight tensor
review_FPGMPruner_sparsity: review the FPGMPruner class and its sparsity level clamping behavior for filter pruning
